names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 5 iunie, «Sfântul Sfințit Mucenic Dorotei, Episcopul Tirului».
Read out of saint.gr's line for 5 Ιουνίου, «Άγιος Δωρόθεος Ιερομάρτυρας επίσκοπος Τύρου», with the rank word left off.

Read out of the Охридски пролог’s heading for 5. јун ст. ст., „Свештеномученик Доротеј, епископ Тирски“ — Свештеномученик is the `hieromartyr` this corpus puts in `types`, епископ the `bishop` it puts there and the `Bishop` in `office`, and „Тирски“ is the see, which the display name already carries. `foldchk.py` returns `[('dorotheus-the-hermit-of-egypt', 'sr')]`: a fold of two on the bare form, deliberate, the other man being a hermit of Egypt kept on another day.

attestations.note: Not checked: days.pravoslavie.ru for the corresponding Julian day (24 September 2026).

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 5 iunie — «Sfântul Sfințit Mucenic Dorotei, Episcopul Tirului»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 5ης Ιουνίου — «Άγιος Δωρόθεος Ιερομάρτυρας επίσκοπος Τύρου»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 5 Ιουνίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing and the same day as the folder's Romanian row, and dates him «(255 - 362)». The same day's listing carries a second entry, «Όσιος Θεόδωρος επίσκοπος Τύρου» (`/1822/`), whose page carries saint.gr's asterisk and which says of itself that its life «μοιάζει αρκετά με τον βίο του Αγίου Δωροθέου επισκόπου Τύρου που εορτάζει και αυτός στις 5 Ιουνίου» — that it resembles this man's life closely. That entry is refused on the asterisk and no folder or row is made from it, and nothing of it is brought over here. saint.gr prints three apolytikia, three kontakia, two megalynaria and an oikos for Dorotheus; the first apolytikion is taken.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 18.06.2026 (5. јун ст. ст.) — „Свештеномученик Доротеј, епископ Тирски“

attestations.note: The day’s first entry, five lines long. The heading is quoted as the Prologue prints it, without a closing full stop, as every heading of this wave is. A DEATH WIDENED BY ONE YEAR AND A BIRTH DELIBERATELY NOT MOVED WITH IT. The folder held `death` 362 off saint.gr («τον σκότωσαν το 362 μ.Χ.») and `birth` 255 off the same page’s head line «(255 - 362)»; doxologia gives no year at all. This book states „преселио се у живот вечни 361. године“. Two books, two flat years: `death` 361 to 362, display «361 or 362». **`birth` STAYS FLAT AT 255 AND THAT IS THE READING, NOT AN OVERSIGHT.** Both books give the same length of life, a hundred and seven years, so 361 minus 107 would make 254 and the birth would widen to 254 to 255 — **but that is a lifespan used to derive a year, which this wave has refused six times, and 255 is a figure saint.gr prints in its own head line rather than one anybody computed.** The derived year is named here so the gap is visible and is not a slip. ONE THING NEW, AND IT IS A TITLE. Both earlier pages have the learning and the writings in Greek and Latin; doxologia names the lives of the prophets and of the apostles, saint.gr a work on the seventy disciples. **This book names a different work and names it famous**: „Нарочито је чувена његова грчко-латинска Синтагма“, his Greek-Latin Syntagma. Everything else is already here: the see held from Diocletian’s day to Julian the Apostate’s, the torments under Julian, the hundred and seven years. `types` and `office` UNTOUCHED, both corroborated by Свештеномученик and епископ. No `locations`, no `related`: this entry names no person but the two emperors, and an emperor in a life is not a relation. THE FOLD IS DELIBERATE: `foldchk.py` returns `[('dorotheus-the-hermit-of-egypt', 'sr')]`, so storing the bare form makes a fold of two; the see came off as §6 and the 25 May `therapon-of-cyprus` reading require, and the two men are told apart by a see against a desert. The Prologue prints no troparion and no kontakion; the day carries only the verse.

hymns.text: Şi părtaş obiceiurilor şi următor scaunelor apostolilor fiind, lucrare ai aflat, de Dumnezeu insuflate, spre suirea privirii la cele înalte. Pentru aceasta, cuvântul adevărului drept învăţând şi cu credinţa răbdând până la sânge Sfinţite Mucenice Dorotei, roagă-te lui Hristos Dumnezeu să mântuiască sufletele noastre.

source.text: Doxologia — Troparul Sfântului Sfințit Mucenic Dorotei, Episcopul Tirului, Glasul 4

english.text: A sharer of their ways and a successor to the thrones of the apostles, thou didst find in action, O God-inspired, a way to rise to the contemplation of things on high. Therefore, rightly teaching the word of truth and enduring in the faith unto blood, hieromartyr Dorotheus, pray Christ God that our souls may be saved.

hymns.text: Ὡς δώρημα τέλειον, ἐκ τοῦ τῶν φώτων Πατρός, σοφίας τὴν ἔλλαμψιν, ὡς Ἱεράρχης σοφός, ἐδέξω Δωρόθεε• ὅθεν καὶ πλεονάσας, τὸν σὸν τάλαντον μάκαρ, ἤθλησας ὑπὲρ φύσιν, βαθυτάτω ἐν γήρᾳ, πρεσβεύων Ἱερομάρτυς, ὑπὲρ τῶν ψυχῶν ἠμῶν.

source.text: saint.gr, Ἀπολυτίκιον (Κατέβασμα), Ἦχος δ’, Ταχὺ προκατάλαβε, the first of three apolytikia on the page of «Άγιος Δωρόθεος Ιερομάρτυρας επίσκοπος Τύρου»

english.text: As a perfect gift from the Father of lights you received the shining of wisdom, O Dorotheus, being a wise hierarch; and so, having multiplied your talent, blessed one, you contended beyond nature in the deepest old age, interceding, O hieromartyr, for our souls.

birth.note: saint.gr's head line reads «Αγιος Δωροθεος Ιερομαρτυρας Επισκοπος Τυρου (255 - 362)», and the body gives his age at death: «τον σκότωσαν το 362 μ.Χ. ... Τότε ο Δωρόθεος ήταν 107 χρονών». The Охридски пролог for 5. јун ст. ст. gives the same hundred and seven years and a death one year earlier, which would put the birth at 254; that year is NOT recorded, because it would be a lifespan used to derive a year, while 255 is a figure the Greek page prints itself (5 October 2026).

death.note: saint.gr: «οι ειδωλολάτρες ... έπιασαν το Δωρόθεο και αφού τον βασάνισαν ανελέητα τον σκότωσαν το 362 μ.Χ.»; doxologia.ro's life prints no year. The Охридски пролог for 5. јун ст. ст. states one year earlier, flat: „Живео на земљи сто седам година, и угодивши Богу преселио се у живот вечни 361. године“. The interval is widened to hold both and neither is chosen (5 October 2026).
